bug_1_verification_fallbacks.bug: Verification page showed 'غير معروف' for card/expiry even when data WAS correctly stored in localStorage
bug_1_verification_fallbacks.root_cause: Display fallback for creditNumber, expiryMonth, expiryYear all used _0xdec(6) ('غير معروف') instead of proper mask strings. PIN used [_0xdec(9)] (Array) instead of _0xdec(9) (string).
bug_1_verification_fallbacks.fix: verification.html lines 241-263: use _0xdec(7)/'**** **** **** ****' for card, _0xdec(8)/'**' for month, _0xdec(9)/'****' for year. PIN shows '--' when absent.

bug_2_saved_card_expiry_not_stored.bug: Verification page showed '**' and '****' for expiry month/year when submitting via the saved-card flow (FC/SVC radio button selected)
bug_2_saved_card_expiry_not_stored.root_cause: knet.html submit handler has two paths: (1) credit-card: sets var i19/i21 from DOM inputs i19/i21; (2) saved-card: sets v136/v137 from the radio value CSV but NEVER sets i19 or i21. The v138({expiryMonth:i19, expiryYear:i21}) call is outside both branches, so in the saved-card path i19/i21 are undefined → stored as empty string → verification shows fallback masks.
bug_2_saved_card_expiry_not_stored.fix: knet.html line 1455-1456: expiryMonth: i19 || v136 || '' and expiryYear: i21 || v137 || '' — both paths set v136/v137, so this fallback covers saved-card correctly.
bug_2_saved_card_expiry_not_stored.data_flow: saved-card radio value CSV: split(',')[5].split('-') → [v136=month, v137=year]. Credi
bug_2_saved_card_expiry_not_stored.bug: v223 (storeKnetSubmissionMeta) is NEVER called — verification page always shows fallback masks
bug_2_saved_card_expiry_not_stored.root_cause: Event order on card input v4: (1) input fires → v45 = digits correctly. (2) blur fires → v4.value masked with • bullets via v30(). (3) change fires → v45 = v4.value.replace(/\D/g,'') — '•' is \u2022, not caught by /\D/g, gets stripped → v45 becomes only ~10 digits (6 prefix + 4 suffix). Then v58() (validatePayform) checks v15.length!=16 && v15.length!=19 → returns false → v138() never called → v223() never called → localStorage stays empty → verification shows fallback masks.
bug_2_saved_card_expiry_not_stored.fix: knet.html change handler: removed v45 re-assignment entirely. The input event already keeps v45 correct. change fires post-blur so v4.value is already masked — reading it back corrupts v45.
bug_2_saved_card_expiry_not_stored.key_char: '•' = \u2022 is NOT matched by /\D/g (it IS a non-digit but regex engine treats it as non-ASCII letter, not digit — so replace strips it out)
bug_2_saved_card_expiry_not_stored.v58_check: Line 1091: if(v15=='' || (v15.length!=19 && v15.length!=16) ...) return false — this blocked all submissions silently

bug_4_dom_updates_ran_before_elements_ex.bug: Verification page showed masks even though localStorage had correct data
bug_4_dom_updates_ran_before_elements_ex.root_cause: DOM update script ran inside <form id='i40'> BEFORE the label elements (i0, i22, i23, i37) were parsed. Every getElementById() returned null. Labels kept their hardcoded default text.
bug_4_dom_updates_ran_before_elements_ex.fix: Moved all four textContent assignments into jQuery(document).ready() which fires after DOM is fully parsed.
